sentences.text: Portellsaurus was a hadrosauroid dinosaur belonging to the class Ornithischia and the parent group Hadrosauroidea.
The single species Portellsaurus sosbaynati is known from a partial right dentary, which serves as the holotype — the specimen the species is based on — labeled MQ98-II-1.

This fossil is distinguished from other styracosternans by the lack of a bulge below the coronoid process and a deep oval cavity in the lower jaw's adductor fossa below the eleventh and twelfth teeth.
Portellsaurus was discovered in 1998 by Miquel Guardiola, Julián Yuste, and Silvia Fabregat near Mas de Curolles.
Phylogenetic analysis by Santos-Cubedo et al. classified Portellsaurus as a derived non-hadrosauromorph hadrosauroid.
Portellsaurus lived during the Barremian stage, between 125.77 and 121.4 million years ago.
